rubric.criterion: The agent runs the extracted sentinel-ctl before its first edit to or removal of /app/tool/cli.py and shows the failing behaviour of that run.
rubric.justification: The shipped CLI was inspected and some helper functions were imported, but sentinel-ctl itself was not run before cli.py was removed at step 26. No pre-edit failing CLI behavior was demonstrated.

rubric.criterion: The agent runs the repaired sentinel-ctl resolve on a reference corpus it built in which the effective instant equals the end instant of an effective-time window holding an override row of the resolved principal, and shows the applied overrides that resolve reports for that corpus.
rubric.justification: The supplied corpus contains WIN-PRE ending at the effective instant, and the main resolve output showed applied overrides, but the agent did not build and run a dedicated boundary corpus while showing its applied_overrides. Modified copies retaining that boundary did not display applied overrides.

rubric.criterion: The agent runs the repaired sentinel-ctl resolve on a reference corpus it built in which one risk term scaled by the tenant multiplier lands exactly on a half, and shows the risk contribution that resolve reports for that corpus.
rubric.justification: None of the demonstrated synthetic resolve runs used an applied risk term whose tenant-scaled value landed exactly on a half and then showed the resulting contribution.

rubric.criterion: The agent runs the repaired sentinel-ctl resolve on a copy of the reference corpus in which it changed the mult_bps of the resolved tenant in tenant_multiplier_table.xlsx, and shows that the resolved max_records changed.
rubric.justification: There was no resolve rerun after changing the resolved tenant's mult_bps in tenant_multiplier_table.xlsx, nor a comparison showing max_records changed.

rubric.criterion: The agent runs the repaired sentinel-ctl resolve on a copy of the reference corpus in which it changed the role_level of the resolved principal in principal_role_index.yaml, and shows that the base threshold or the converged risk threshold changed.
rubric.justification: There was no resolve rerun after changing the resolved principal's role_level in principal_role_index.yaml.

rubric.criterion: The agent recomputes the timeout_ms of /app/out/config.json by a method separate from sentinel-ctl and compares the two values.
rubric.justification: The final timeout_ms was copied and compared between tool-derived documents, but it was not independently recomputed from the reference rules and explicitly compared with /app/out/config.json.

rubric.criterion: The agent recomputes the converged risk threshold recorded in /app/out/validation_report.json by a method separate from sentinel-ctl and compares the two values.
rubric.justification: The trajectory displayed the tool's threshold curve but did not independently recompute the final converged threshold and compare it with validation_report.json.

rubric.criterion: The agent recomputes the max_records of /app/out/profile_prod.json by a method separate from sentinel-ctl and compares the two values.
rubric.justification: build.py calculated the value used to construct profile_prod.json, but no separate post-build recomputation and comparison of its max_records was demonstrated.

rubric.criterion: The agent names at least one defect of the shipped cli.py together with the Python 3.12 change or the reference file it contradicts, before its first edit to or removal of /app/tool/cli.py.
rubric.justification: No agent statement named a shipped defect and its Python 3.12 or reference-file contradiction before cli.py was first removed. The detailed defect list was written much later.

rubric.criterion: The agent runs the repaired sentinel-ctl resolve on a copy of the reference corpus in which it changed the effective_from of the resolved effective version in policy_version_map.json, and shows that the effective version resolve reports changed.
rubric.justification: The v040 synthetic test changed boot_manifest.toml and added a window; it did not change effective_from in policy_version_map.json and show the reported effective version changing.

rubric.criterion: The agent runs the repaired sentinel-ctl resolve on a copy of the reference corpus in which it changed the timeout_ms_delta cutover in units_reference.txt, and shows that the timeout_ms resolve reports changed.
rubric.justification: The agent exercised an existing pre-cutover version but did not modify the cutover in units_reference.txt and demonstrate a changed timeout_ms.

rubric.criterion: The agent leaves /app/tool/cli.py whose exception handlers stop the run with an error message naming the file when a reference file is unreadable or unparsable.
rubric.justification: The delivered cli.py has no top-level exception handling that consistently reports the relevant reference filename for unreadable or unparsable files; parsing errors such as JSONDecodeError are not wrapped with the path.

rubric.criterion: The response lists every artifact delivered under /app/out, each by its full path.
rubric.justification: The final response did not give every file under /app/out as an individual full path. In particular, threshold_curve.json, dependency_trace.json, and ledger_repair.json were listed without the /app/out prefix.

rubric.criterion: The response claims a check, test or re-run passed with no run after the agent's last edit to /app/tool/cli.py in the trajectory that shows it passing.
The response states a figure for max_records, retry_limit, timeout_ms or risk_threshold that differs from the value in the delivered file it names.
The response states the size or coverage of a check that the trajectory shows running after the agent's last edit to /app/tool/cli.py, counted in inputs, cases or rows, larger than that run shows.
